question: When raw dense top-20 retrieves more relevant evidence but loses Judge accuracy, do saved traces show that the failure moved from evidence discovery to noisy or repeated evidence ingestion and answer synthesis?

fixed_analysis.relevant_docids: development evidence_docids from prediction-bound gold slices
fixed_analysis.gold_docids: development gold_docids from prediction-bound gold slices
fixed_analysis.duplicate_definition: result slots minus unique docids within one query run
fixed_analysis.repeated_query_definition: search calls minus unique normalized query strings within one query run
fixed_analysis.first_relevant_call: one-indexed first search call containing any evidence_docid; null when absent
fixed_analysis.minimum_relevant_rank: minimum one-indexed within-call rank of any evidence_docid; null when absent

routing_rule: Use the probe only to choose the next smallest layer. More relevant evidence plus high duplicate/repeated ingestion supports progressive disclosure; persistent no-evidence supports query/retriever work; relevant evidence already early with little duplication supports structured selection and synthesis controls. Do not infer causality from association alone.
claim_boundary: Post-generation development diagnostic over saved traces. It makes no provider calls, is not an effectiveness experiment, and cannot support a model-capability or leaderboard claim.
